title: Best time to photograph Zhangjiajie
text: Mountain light differs from lowlands. Golden hour sunrise 5:30-6:30 in summer, 7-8 in winter. Blue hour sunset 19-20 summer, 17-17:30 winter. Foggy mornings after rainy nights deliver the iconic Avatar look. Avoid 11-14 - flat overhead light kills depth.

title: Glamping and unusual stays in Zhangjiajie
text: Alternative accommodations for nature lovers: glass houses on mountain slopes with panoramic windows (600-1,200 yuan), traditional Tujia village homestays (200-400), in-park guesthouses at Tianzi Mountain (500-800), seasonal glamping tents (300-500) and cave hotels near Huanglong (400-700).

title: Hotels in Fenghuang ancient town
text: Fenghuang is a historic Miao town 4 hours from Zhangjiajie, typically visited for 1-2 days. River-view hotels inside the old town cost 300-800 yuan, outside the walls 150-400 yuan, hostels 80-200. Book a river view balcony for the magical evening lantern-lit scenes.

title: Hotels near Tianmen Mountain
text: Tianmen is a separate mountain next to Zhangjiajie city and the cable car starts from the city station - so Tianmen hotels are city hotels. Picks near the cable car: Tianmen Hotel (300-500 yuan), Jinhai Hotel (200-350 yuan), hostels (100-150). Close to the Fox Fairy show theatre too.

title: Hotels in Zhangjiajie city
text: The city sits 35 km from the park but next to Tianmen, ideal if combining Tianmen with the main park. Hotels cost 30-50% less than Wulingyuan with more restaurants and life. Recommended: Kyriad Marvelous (400-700), Mingjia (250-400), GreenTree Inn (150-250) and hostels near Tianmen cable car.
